home.heading: Things I'm making
home.intro: The world doesn't need another blog. This one is primarily designed to motivate me to complete these works. An Idea becomes a Project when I post it on here. All Project posts start with questions. Nothing gets called Art until it's made. There's some strange stuff here but I hope you find it interesting.

updates.heading: Project updates
updates.intro: Short updates on my progress: decisions, prototypes, photos, failures, successes.

handsOn.heading: Try them here
handsOn.intro: Digital things you can only experience on this site, and 3D models of some the physical work to examine in more detail.

notArt.heading: Other things I'm building
notArt.intro: When asked "What do you do for a job?" my answer is usually to describe one or both of these things.

contact.heading: Get in touch
contact.intro: Let me know if you have any questions about a piece or just want to say hello.
